title: Zymo Quick-DNA HMW MagBead Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place samples in a NEST deepwell plate on the magnetic module; refer to the reagent layout for the 12‑channel and 1‑channel reservoirs as described in the Setup section.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the designated fields of the OT App.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files to upload.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing plates, reservoirs, tip racks, and the magnetic module in their specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine; consult support articles for tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the protocol.
